claimText: Aircraft utilizing RNAV may be cleared to climb or descend to or through the levels occupied by other aircraft utilizing RNAV provided it has been positively established by simultaneous RNAV distance readings to or from the same 'on-track' common point that the aircraft have passed each other and are at least 150 km (80 NM) apart.
rationale: Consistent authoritative permission for reciprocal track clearance with RNAV.
